entry.title: New: Resolution 243 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PAYMENT OF FUNDS OF LATER FISCAL YEARS FOR AN EXTENSION OF A MULTI-YEAR LEASE AGREEMENT FOR REAL PROPERTY TO BE USED BY THE HAWAI‘I POLICE DEPARTMENT

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into a five-year lease agreement, with an option to extend for an additional five years, with Geo Investment Company, Inc., with an estimated monthly cost of $8,520 for the first year, with a 7 percent increase per year for years two through five, for commercial warehouse space located at Kea‘au.
